Value = Type (Plus Int | Minus Int).
Tree = Type (Leaf | Branch Tree Value Tree).
make d n = if d <= 0 then Leaf else
  left = make (d - 1) (n+1); right = make (d - 1) (n+2);
  v = if n % 2 == 0 then Plus n else Minus n; Branch left v right.
score t = case t of Leaf -> 0 | Branch l v r -> case v of
  Plus x -> score l + x + score r | Minus x -> score l - x + score r.
work d x = t = make d 1; a = score t; x - a - score t.

Choice = Type (Plus Int | Minus Int).
buildCells n = if n <= 0 then [] else (if n % 2 == 0 then Plus n else Minus n) :: buildCells (n - 1).
readCells xs a = case xs of [] -> a | h :: tail -> case h of Plus v -> readCells tail (a+v) | Minus v -> readCells tail (a - v).
work n x = xs = buildCells n; a = readCells xs x; readCells xs a.
